text: Hemi performed today.
why: "Hemi" alone with no other context is genuinely ambiguous between hemicolectomy, hip hemiarthroplasty and hemithyroidectomy. Live testing shows Jev leans towards reading bare "hemi" as hemiarthroplasty or hemithyroidectomy rather than hemicolectomy; only the hemicolectomy exclusion is asserted here, and the ambiguity is otherwise left as a documented judgment call rather than a hard expectation.
